# Mongabay

> Global platform for conservation and environmental science reporting, investigating wildlife trafficking, biodiversity threats, and indigenous rights with rigorous investigative journalism.

Mongabay is a leading independent news organization dedicated to environmental reporting and conservation journalism. The site covers critical issues including illegal wildlife trade, biodiversity protection, indigenous peoples' rights, and environmental crime across Asia, Africa, and Latin America.

## Key Topics

- wildlife trafficking
- endangered species
- biodiversity conservation
- indigenous rights
- investigative journalism
- environmental crime
- deep-sea mining
- climate change
- illegal wildlife trade
- Indonesia
- Asia
- wildlife protection
- environmental news
- conservation
- carbon trading

## News & Content Hub

- [Homepage](https://news.mongabay.com): Main landing page for conservation and environmental science news
- [Articles](https://news.mongabay.com/articles): Full-length conservation articles covering wildlife trade and biodiversity protection
- [Features](https://news.mongabay.com/features): In-depth feature stories on wildlife conservation and environmental crime
- [Shorts](https://news.mongabay.com/shorts): Short-form conservation news on amphibian rewilding and endangered species
- [All News](https://news.mongabay.com/list/all): Archive listing all conservation news and environmental reporting

## Multimedia & Investigations

- [Investigative Reports](https://news.mongabay.com/2026/03/facebook-shuts-indonesia-groups-after-mongabay-and-bellingcat-report-illegal-wildlife-trade): Investigative reporting on illegal wildlife trade leads to Facebook enforcement
- [Wildlife Trafficking Investigation](https://news.mongabay.com/2026/03/proboscis-monkey-found-in-thailand-adds-to-evidence-of-cross-border-illegal-trade): Wildlife trafficking investigation reveals cross-border illegal trade in Asia
- [Videos](https://news.mongabay.com/videos): Video content on wildlife conservation and endangered species
- [Podcasts](https://news.mongabay.com/podcasts): Podcast series featuring conservation experts like Jane Goodall
- [Specials](https://news.mongabay.com/specials): Curated special collections and documentary films on conservation
